text:
ITEM 1 | Leafy greens mix, dark green spinach-like leaves with some lighter green small leaves and thin reddish-purple stems, plus scattered thin orange shreds (carrot-like), loosely piled on the left side of the plate, fresh and slightly glossy, covering roughly 30% of the plate | 90
ITEM 2 | Cooked light-tan chunky pieces with fibrous shredded texture and a golden-brown crumbly coating/crust on edges, slightly moist with a sheen, piled in the center-right, roughly 2-3 cm pieces, about 20% of the plate | 110
ITEM 3 | Sliced green zucchini-like rounds and wedges, bright green skin with pale yellow-green flesh, one wedge cut into a curved half-moon, slightly glossy and firm, sitting beside the chicken-like pieces on the lower right, about 4 cm across, about 8% of the plate | 60
ITEM 4 | Yellow squash-like pieces, pale yellow with slightly darker edges, soft-looking, cut into curved chunks about 3 cm, glossy and moist, lower right of plate near the green slices | 45
ITEM 5 | Dark green pieces with some charred or darker spots, tender-looking, mixed among the tan pieces in the upper right, about 2 cm, slightly glossy | 35
